prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: M11 Cargo Leader FUTURISTIC ELECTRIC CARGO TRUCK design master R2.
Input image 1 is the existing vehicle to redesign. Retain its ivory/navy/safety-orange color identity, detachable SINGLE full-size cargo box, rigid four-axle chassis, heavy-load role, and crisp mechanical animation illustration medium. The user explicitly wants a more futuristic vehicle inspired by TESLA SEMI, with a corresponding robot redesign to follow.
PRIMARY CHANGE: replace the old flat-front diesel cab and enormous three-tier radiator grille with an ORIGINAL streamlined electric heavy truck cab. Use Tesla Semi's broad design idea only: a tall cab with a sloping continuous roof, very large single wraparound dark-blue windshield, swept-back A pillars, smooth rounded wedge nose, integrated flush lamps, deeply sculpted aerodynamic side cheeks, enclosed side battery/underbody fairings. This is NOT Cybertruck: no crude stainless pyramid, no sharp low-poly wedge. It must feel like an advanced transport partner and noble powerful leader, not a bus, train, race car, or military gun truck.
CAB SHAPE: original ivory shell flows from sloping curved windshield to a smooth broad navy-and-ivory nose shield. Windshield is a SINGLE continuous dark curved visor with no vertical divider and NO twin square windows. Shallow navy lower intake, small amber central marker and paired narrow angled amber running lights; NO stacked black radiator grille. Add small orange functional hatch catches and orange joint/pin accents sparingly, matching input palette. Side cameras sit flush in body; no long mirror stalks, no lateral rods or antenna.
FINITE CHASSIS: preserve FOUR axles / EIGHT road wheel positions total. Show exactly FOUR separate near-side tire positions: one near cab front, second under rear of cab, rear tandem under cargo deck. Wheel tops tucked into smooth navy aero fairings with ivory trim, lower tire arcs still visible/countable, original small orange wheel center hubs and thick black rubber. No extra wheels or floating maglev, no tracks. One integrated rigid load-bearing truck, NOT tractor plus semi-trailer.
CARGO: exactly one normal-volume detachable freight container on rear flatbed, ivory broad smooth sides with subtle structural ribs, navy perimeter rails and orange corner blocks/twist-locks. Slightly smoother aero leading corners than old box but still usable rectangular independent freight container. Narrow visible attachment line between cargo and deck. No roof guns or extra container. The unoccupied cargo deck/chassis will become the robot's shallow folded back frame.
Composition: ONE complete truck in clear front-left three-quarter view, nose lower-left, rear upper-right, landscape with all vehicle extremities visible and generous margins. Keep weight-bearing practical proportions but reduce the old brick-like blunt cab. It must look recognizably FUTURISTIC even at thumbnail size, with the enormous wraparound cockpit and sculpted smooth front.
Style: polished Japanese mecha animation design, crisp dark linework, clean ivory/navy planes, restrained cel shading, tiny edge wear only, warm off-white studio background and soft ground shadow. Not photorealistic. No Tesla logo, no brand, no text or lettering, no diagram, no robot, no humans, no inset.
